text_block_list.text:
Although Смарт Фалкон is training
intensely in
preparation for the Satsuki
Sho, it doesn't seem
to be bearing fruit.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She looks to Сайленс Судзука, who is
making a
name for herself on turf, for
help.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука wows audiences with
both her
running and singing. In Smart
Falcon's eyes, she is
the very image of
perfection.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон's training session with
Silence
Suzuka further strengthens her
resolve to take on
the Satsuki Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
